Confidence Score: 4/5 [Medium impact] The change affects queue worker runs and the delivery records they update. Fix the loop bounds before merging so every due job gets processed. Findings Small batches never get delivered ▶ Summary The PR batches receipt inserts and delivery updates in groups of twenty. It needs one fix before merging: the loop skips every final group smaller than twenty. The re

Small batches never get delivered. The loop stops at len(jobs) - batch_size + 1, so it only visits full groups of twenty. With 19 due jobs, deliver_due returns zero without writing anything; with 21, it delivers twenty and leaves one pending. Repeated calls cannot clear the remaining jobs unless more arrive. Use range(0, len(jobs), batch_size) so the final slice is processed too.
